en: pivoting rapidly on one foot, opposite knee lifted, one arm sweeping horizontally and the other bent near the torso
ja: アクション：片足を軸に素早く回転し反対の膝を上げ、片腕を水平に振って反対の腕を体へ寄せる

en: braking from a run with one heel planted forward, rear knee bent, torso leaning back and both arms spread sideways
ja: アクション：走りから前のかかとを踏んで急停止し、後ろ膝を曲げ上体を後ろへ傾け両腕を横へ広げる

en: performing a running leap with the rear knee bent backward, front leg reaching forward, one arm stretched overhead and the other extended sideways
ja: アクション：助走から前脚を前へ伸ばし後ろ膝を曲げて跳び、片腕を頭上、反対の腕を横へ伸ばす
